method: Six distinct C functions compile to five Thumb self-branches and one BX LR. A dedicated retained section keeps them in the source-linked CASE image; the concatenated twelve linked bytes equal the six locked instruction encodings. The functions are not placed at their stock addresses.
limits: The isolated BX LR has no proven incoming entry; C models its shipped return instruction without asserting reachability.

The six functions are not at stock addresses. Closing this preexisting gap frontier does not prove all CASE instruction/data coverage, whole-firmware source completeness, byte identity or device behavior.
